system.description:
The Ravnos's command of illusion becomes so effortless that her lower Chimerstry powers cost her nothing at all, and she may weave many illusions at once without conscious effort.

System: The Ravnos pays no Blood or Willpower cost to use Ignis Fatuus, Fata Morgana, or Apparition (the first three levels of Chimerstry). She may direct a number of independent illusions equal to her Intelligence without needing to concentrate on any of them, and any such illusion may persist at a distance up to her Willpower score in miles.

MET: Elder Discipline. The Ravnos pays no Trait cost to invoke Basic Chimerstry or the first Intermediate Chimerstry power. Such illusions may behave with full complexity without requiring the Ravnos's ongoing concentration, and persist until sunrise unless the Ravnos spends a Blood Trait to make one permanent.
